title_en: 10 Marathon Routes That Are The Boeing 777-300ER's Longest In 2026
title_zh: 2026 年波音 777-300ER 最长的 10 条马拉松航线
summary: The 777 remains extremely popular with airlines for long-haul flights.
summary_zh: 777 仍然深受航空公司长途航班的欢迎。
body_en: The Boeing 777 is hardly the newest or most capable long-range airliner in service today, but it remains a reliable workhorse for airlines worldwide. With over 2,000 examples delivered, the 777 is the most popular widebody program ever, and it's still a popular machine for long-haul and ultra-long-haul flights. The 777-300ER in particular stands out for its compelling operating costs and is the most ordered variant by far.
body_zh: 波音 777 很难说是当今服役的最新型或功能最强大的远程客机，但它仍然是全球航空公司可靠的主力飞机。 777 已交付超过 2,000 架，是有史以来最受欢迎的宽体飞机项目，并且仍然是长途和超长途航班的热门机型。 777-300ER 因其引人注目的运营成本而尤其引人注目，是迄今为止订购最多的型号。

title_en: 6 Airlines Offering Lie-Flat Economy Sleep Products For A Fraction Of Business Class
title_zh: 6 家航空公司为部分商务舱提供平躺式经济睡眠产品
summary: Many airlines now emulate Air New Zealand's Skycouches to offer lie-flat economy products.
summary_zh: 许多航空公司现在效仿新西兰航空的 Skyouches 提供平躺式经济舱产品。
body_en: In November, Air New Zealand is set to launch Skynests on its Auckland to New York route. Economy class passengers will be able to book six bunk-style pods for a four-hour session. The cost, according to Yahoo , will be $495 per session. However, Skynest is far from the first time that economy class passengers can lie flat. Air New Zealand pioneered the idea with its Skycouch product, with passengers able to book an entire row and lie flat by flipping up the armrests.
body_zh: 11 月，新西兰航空计划在奥克兰至纽约航线上推出 Skynests。经济舱乘客将可以预订六个双层舱，为期四小时。据雅虎称，每次会议的费用为 495 美元。然而，Skynest并不是第一次让经济舱乘客平躺。新西兰航空通过其 Skycouch 产品率先实现了这一理念，乘客可以通过翻转扶手来预订整排座位并平躺。

title_en: The World’s Shortest Scheduled Flight Can Take Just 53 Seconds
title_zh: 世界上最短的定期航班只需 53 秒
summary: A compact inter-island operation blends record lore with lifeline utility as Orkney debates ferries, bridges and tunnels.
summary_zh: 当奥克尼群岛就渡轮、桥梁和隧道展开争论时，紧凑的岛际行动将创纪录的传说与生命线实用性融为一体。
body_en: 32 minutes is all it takes to travel between North Carolina's two largest cities, Raleigh and Charlotte onboard American Airlines . For a key connecting market for Raleigh–Durham International Airport (RDU), Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) serves over 525,000 passengers annually . At an unusually short flight time, the flight is quite often equipped with a larger Airbus A321 .
body_zh: 乘坐美国航空 32 分钟即可往返于北卡罗来纳州最大的两个城市罗利和夏洛特。夏洛特道格拉斯国际机场 (CLT) 是罗利-达勒姆国际机场 (RDU) 的重要转机市场，每年为超过 525,000 名乘客提供服务。在飞行时间异常短的情况下，航班通常配备较大的空客 A321。

title_en: United Airlines Opens Flight Attendant Bases In… Dallas & Sacramento?!
title_zh: 美国联合航空公司在……达拉斯和萨克拉门托开设空乘基地？！
summary: United Airlines is opening two new flight attendant bases, in Dallas and Sacramento. The Dallas choice is the real surprise, given American's fortress hub there and United's small presence.
summary_zh: 联合航空将在达拉斯和萨克拉门托开设两个新的空乘人员基地。考虑到美国航空的堡垒，达拉斯的选择确实令人惊讶
body_en: Several weeks ago, United Airlines revealed internally that it would open two new flight attendant bases in the near future. We’ve now learned the details of where these bases will be, and I’m kind of caught off guard by them… especially one! I’m curious if anyone has any insights or theories.
United reveals its two newest flight attendant bases

Airlines have flight attendant bases at certain airports. While lots of flight attendants choose to commute, the idea is that flight attendants typically start and their trips at their base. These bases are important, since there will also often be reserve flight attendants there on standby, in case they need to fill in for someone else, to keep the operation moving.

As things currently stand, United has roughly a dozen flight attendant bases. There are bases at all the carrier’s hubs, and also in places like Guam (GUM) and London (LHR), which are more focus cities than hubs. There are also bases in places like Boston (BOS) and Honolulu (HNL), reflecting the amount of service the airline has there.
Anyway, JonNYC reports on how United has just revealed its two newest flight attendant bases, and they’re in Dallas (DFW) and Sacramento (SMF).
body_zh: 几周前，美联航内部透露，将在不久的将来开设两个新的空乘基地。我们现在已经了解了这些基地的详细位置，我对它们有点措手不及……尤其是一个！我很好奇是否有人有任何见解或理论。
美联航公布其两个最新的空乘人员基地
航空公司在某些机场设有空乘人员基地。虽然许多空乘人员选择通勤，但我们的想法是空乘人员通常在他们的基地开始旅行。这些基地很重要，因为那里经常会有后备空乘人员待命，以防他们需要顶替其他人，以保持行动顺利进行。
就目前情况而言，美联航拥有大约十几个空乘人员基地。该航空公司的所有枢纽均设有基地，关岛 (GUM) 和伦敦 (LHR) 等地也设有基地，这些城市比枢纽城市更重要。在波士顿 (BOS) 和檀香山 (HNL) 等地也设有基地，这反映了该航空公司在那里提供的服务量。
无论如何，JonNYC 报道了联合航空刚刚公布的两个最新空乘人员基地，分别位于达拉斯 (DFW) 和萨克拉门托 (SMF)。

title_en: How Cabin Crew Will Rest & Sleep On Long Boeing 777X Flights
title_zh: 空乘人员如何在波音 777X 长途飞行中休息和睡眠
summary: Better crew rest facilities and new rules are important factors in this discourse.
summary_zh: 更好的船员休息设施和新规则是这次讨论的重要因素。
body_en: The Boeing 777X , like most widebody long-haul aircraft, has crew rest areas for the pilots and cabin crew. These are important so that they can try and get some sleep on long sectors, reducing fatigue and ensuring alertness and safety during flights. These special areas are hidden away from the main passenger deck, usually above in the aircraft's crown or below in the cargo hold, accessed by a hidden door and a steep staircase.
body_zh: 与大多数宽体长途飞机一样，波音 777X 设有供飞行员和机组人员休息的区域。这些很重要，这样他们就可以在长途飞行中尝试获得一些睡眠，减少疲劳并确保飞行期间的警觉性和安全性。这些特殊区域隐藏在远离主乘客甲板的地方，通常位于飞机的顶部上方或货舱下方，可通过隐藏的门和陡峭的楼梯进入。

title_en: We Tracked A Boeing 737 For 24 Hours: Here's How Many Flights It Squeezed In
title_zh: 我们对一架波音 737 进行了 24 小时追踪：以下是它挤进了多少航班
summary: Have you ever wondered where a 737 goes on an average day? We tracked a Ryanair (Malta Air) 737 for 24 hours, and here is where it went.
summary_zh: 您是否想知道 737 平日都去哪里？我们对一架瑞安航空（马耳他航空）737 飞机进行了 24 小时的跟踪，以下是它的去向。
body_en: European aviation thrives on relentless efficiency, and few aircraft illustrate this operational discipline quite like a Ryanair Boeing 737-800, one of the most common sights in European skies and airports alike. Operating under the Malta Air certificate with registration 9H-QEB, this single narrowbody airframe goes on a very tough multi-sector rotation, day in and day out, that puts commercial aviation logistics on full display. To see just how much work this aircraft actually goes through, we tracked this specific aircraft for an entire day on Monday, October 12, a day where an eight-flight marathon occurred, crisscrossing the continent from Mediterranean island bases to northern European hubs.
body_zh: 欧洲航空业依靠不懈的效率而蓬勃发展，很少有飞机能像瑞安航空波音 737-800 那样体现这种运营纪律，它是欧洲天空和机场最常见的景象之一。这架窄体机身拥有马耳他航空证书，注册号为 9H-QEB，它日复一日地进行非常艰难的多部门轮换，充分展示了商业航空物流。为了了解这架飞机实际完成了多少工作，我们在 10 月 12 日星期一一整天跟踪了这架特定的飞机，这一天发生了一场八次航班的马拉松比赛，从地中海岛屿基地到北欧枢纽，纵横欧洲大陆。

title_en: The Abandoned WWII Airfield The US Air Force Is Rebuilding Into A Forward Pacific Base
title_zh: 美国空军正在将废弃的二战机场改建为太平洋前沿基地
summary: Why the USAF is restoring ruins on the far flung island of Tinian.
summary_zh: 为什么美国空军要在遥远的天宁岛修复废墟。
body_en: Until only recently, jungles covered the historic US Air Force (USAF) runway that once hosted the Boeing B-29 bombers chosen to drop the only atomic weapons ever used in anger in the final days of WWII. The once-abandoned North Field of Tinian lies on a small island in the Northern Mariana Islands , which was once so dominated by planes that soldiers jested the island had transformed into an 'aircraft carrier.' Over the subsequent eight decades, it has been completely consumed by tropical overgrowth. Now, US Air Force engineers are aggressively repaving that old coral ground, completing a huge rehabilitation project.
body_zh: 直到最近，丛林还覆盖了历史悠久的美国空军 (USAF) 跑道，这里曾经停泊过波音 B-29 轰炸机，这些轰炸机在二战最后几天被选择投掷唯一一种在愤怒中使用过的原子武器。曾经废弃的天宁岛北田位于北马里亚纳群岛的一个小岛上，该岛曾经被飞机占据，以至于士兵们戏称该岛已经变成了“航空母舰”。在随后的八年里，它已完全被热带过度生长所吞噬。现在，美国空军工程师正在积极修复这片古老的珊瑚地，完成一项庞大的修复工程。

title_en: Brutal: Delta Struggling Across The Pacific, Making Even American Look Good
title_zh: 残酷：达美航空在太平洋上挣扎，甚至让美国人看起来不错
summary: Delta's Q3 2026 Pacific results show capacity growing faster than yield for a second straight quarter, while United and American both saw yields comfortably outpace capacity.
summary_zh: 达美航空 2026 年第三季度太平洋地区业绩显示，运力增长连续第二个季度快于收益率，而联合航空和美国航空的收益率均表现出色
body_en: Delta is currently making a huge push to expand across the Pacific, claiming it wants to beat United there . It’s a region in which Delta has been weak in recent years, at least when it comes to serving anything beyond Seoul Incheon (ICN), the hub for joint venture partner Korean Air.

A few months ago, I took a look at the data of how poorly Delta is performing across the Pacific , following the “big three” carriers reporting their Q2 2026 earnings. With all three of the airlines having now reported their Q3 2026 earnings, I’d like to take a look at the latest. Are things getting better or worse for Delta?
The math on Delta’s expansion isn’t pretty right now

With American, Delta, and United, having all reported their Q3 2026 earnings, I think it’s interesting to look at how all airlines did across the Pacific in the quarter, at least directionally. I’m not doing this to pick on Delta (I swear), and I’ll explain more later. But first let’s look at the actual math, and thanks to JonNYC for bringing this up.
I’d like to compare performance across the Pacific in the last two quarters between American, Delta, and United. Just to define the terms here:
Yield is the passenger revenue divided by the number of revenue passenger miles flown, so it reflects what people are actually paying to fly, and doesn’t account for empty seats
PRASM is the passenger revenue per available seat mile, and you calculate that by taking the total passenger revenue and dividing it by the number of seats, so it factors in empty seats
body_zh: 达美航空目前正在大力推动在太平洋地区的扩张，声称它希望在那里击败联合航空。近年来，达美航空在这个地区一直表现疲弱，至少在提供除首尔仁川机场（ICN）（合资伙伴大韩航空的枢纽机场）以外的服务方面是如此。
几个月前，在“三大”航空公司公布 2026 年第二季度收益之后，我查看了达美航空在太平洋地区表现不佳的数据。目前这三家航空公司均已公布 2026 年第三季度的收益，我想了解一下最新情况。达美航空的情况是变得更好了还是更糟了？

title_en: United Airlines Boeing 777-200 Drops Over 3,000 Feet Mid-Flight, 4 Flight Attendants Injured
title_zh: 联合航空波音 777-200 飞机在飞行途中从 3,000 英尺高空坠落，4 名空乘人员受伤
summary: Four United Airlines flight attendants were injured during turbulence near Los Angeles, raising questions about increasingly turbulent Pacific flights
summary_zh: 四名联合航空空乘人员在洛杉矶附近的湍流中受伤，引发人们对太平洋航班日益动荡的质疑
body_en: Four flight attendants were injured aboard a United Airlines flight from Daniel K. Inouye International Airport (HNL) to Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) on Wednesday, after the Boeing 777-200 encountered severe turbulence during its descent. The Los Angeles Times reported that UA1157 descended more than 3,000 feet (914 meters) in about one minute, though this altitude change does not necessarily indicate an uncontrolled drop caused by turbulence. One flight attendant was hospitalized, while none of the 190 passengers were reported injured.
body_zh: 周三，联合航空从丹尼尔·井上国际机场 (HNL) 飞往洛杉矶国际机场 (LAX) 的一架波音 777-200 客机在下降过程中遭遇严重颠簸，导致四名空乘人员受伤。 《洛杉矶时报》报道称，UA1157 在大约一分钟内下降了 3,000 多英尺（914 米），不过这种高度变化并不一定表明是由湍流引起的失控下降。一名空乘人员被送往医院，190 名乘客据报无人受伤。

title_en: Coffin Corner: Here's What Worries Pilots Most When Flying Above 40,000 Feet
title_zh: 棺材角：飞行高度超过 40,000 英尺时，飞行员最担心的是什么
summary: Low oxygen, high stall speeds, and thin air require pilots to be very focused at high altitudes.
summary_zh: 低氧、高失速速度和稀薄的空气要求飞行员在高空高度集中注意力。
body_en: Aircraft today routinely cruise above 40,000 feet (12,192 meters), operating in an environment where aerodynamic performance, aircraft systems, and human physiology all approach critical limits simultaneously. At those altitudes, the margin for error narrows dramatically. A small change in airspeed, turbulence intensity, aircraft weight, or pilot input can push an aircraft toward conditions from which recovery becomes increasingly difficult. Among pilots and aerospace engineers, few concepts illustrate this better than “coffin corner,” the high-altitude region where the safe operating speed range becomes exceptionally narrow.
body_zh: 如今，飞机通常会在 40,000 英尺（12,192 米）以上的高度上巡航，在空气动力性能、飞机系统和人体生理学都同时接近临界极限的环境中运行。在这些高度上，误差范围急剧缩小。空速、湍流强度、飞机重量或飞行员输入的微小变化都可能使飞机变得越来越难以恢复。对于飞行员和航空航天工程师来说，很少有概念比“棺材角”更能说明这一点，即安全运行速度范围变得异常狭窄的高空区域。

title_en: JetBlue Premium Upgrade Certificates Overhaul: How To Earn & Redeem Them
title_zh: 捷蓝航空高级升舱证书大修：如何赚取和兑换它们
summary: JetBlue is rebranding Move to Mint certificates as Premium Upgrade Certificates, now valid for Mint and BlueFirst, with new ways for Mosaic members to earn them.
summary_zh: 捷蓝航空正在将 Move to Mint 证书重新命名为 Premium Upgrade 证书，现在对 Mint 和 BlueFirst 有效，为 Mosaic 会员提供了新的方式
body_en: It’s an interesting time for JetBlue, given that the airline is introducing a first class product . I’ve just covered how JetBlue will be rolling out unlimited complimentary upgrades for Mosaic elite members , but that’s not the only update we’re seeing.

JetBlue is also rebranding its Move to Mint certificates as Premium Upgrade Certificates, reflecting the fact that these won’t just be redeemable for Mint business class, but also for BlueFirst first class. While these were first introduced back in 2022, there will be more opportunities to earn and redeem them, so let’s cover those details.
How to earn JetBlue Premium Upgrade Certificates

JetBlue TrueBlue members will soon have more opportunities to earn Premium Upgrade Certificates. As in the past, JetBlue will continue to let members earn the following number of Premium Upgrade Certificates based on the status they qualify for:
Mosaic 3 status (which requires 150 tiles) will offer four Premium Upgrade Certificates
Mosaic 4 status (which requires 250 tiles) will offer four Premium Upgrade Certificates
Mosaic 4 members can earn two additional Premium Upgrade Certificates for every 100 tiles earned beyond 250

For context, you earn one tile for every $100 in qualifying JetBlue spending, and one tile for every $1,000 in qualifying JetBlue credit card spending. That means Mosaic 3 requires $15,000 in JetBlue spending or $150,000 in credit card spending.
body_zh: 对于捷蓝航空来说，这是一个有趣的时刻，因为该航空公司正在推出头等舱产品。我刚刚介绍了捷蓝航空将如何为 Mosaic 精英会员推出无限免费升级，但这并不是我们看到的唯一更新。
捷蓝航空还将其 Move to Mint 证书更名为 Premium Upgrade 证书，反映出这些证书不仅可以兑换 Mint 商务舱，还可以兑换 BlueFirst 头等舱。虽然这些奖励是在 2022 年首次推出的，但将会有更多机会赚取和兑换它们，所以让我们来介绍一下这些细节。
如何获得捷蓝航空高级升舱证书
捷蓝 TrueBlue 会员很快将有更多机会获得高级升级证书。与过去一样，捷蓝航空将继续让会员根据其资格获得以下数量的高级升舱证书：
Mosaic 3 状态（需要 150 个方块）将提供四张高级升级证书
Mosaic 4 状态（需要 250 个方块）将提供四张高级升级证书
Mosaic 4 会员每获得超过 250 块 100 块即可额外获得两张高级升级证书

title_en: WestJet Cancels 10 Nonstop Routes From This Major City: See Full List Now
title_zh: 西捷航空取消从该主要城市出发的 10 条直达航线：立即查看完整列表
summary: Withdrawal from Cuban destinations and cuts to transborder and leisure services reshape Toronto's travel options.
summary_zh: 从古巴目的地撤出以及跨境和休闲服务的削减重塑了多伦多的旅行选择。
body_en: WestJet , Canada's second-largest airline by fleet size and passengers carried, has cut a total of ten routes from the country's largest city this year. Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ) has lost 10 nonstop routes with WestJet, primarily due to the airline withdrawing fully from Cuba . On top of Cuba disappearing from the carrier's route map, one route to Europe and another to the United States have been terminated.
body_zh: 按机队规模和载客量计算，加拿大第二大航空公司西捷航空今年已削减了从该国最大城市出发的总共 10 条航线。多伦多皮尔逊国际机场 (YYZ) 已失去 10 条西捷航空直飞航线，主要原因是该航空公司完全撤出古巴。除了古巴从该航空公司的航线图上消失之外，一条飞往欧洲的航线和另一条飞往美国的航线也被终止。

title_en: The Highest-Paid Aviation Engineering Jobs & Their Average Salaries
title_zh: 薪酬最高的航空工程工作及其平均工资
summary: Top earners in the design office, the production line, and the flightline.
summary_zh: 设计室、生产线和飞行线的收入最高的人。
body_en: Illustrating the upward trend in aviation and aerospace wages, a recent contract update at Boeing has pushed the average salary for the company's engineer union up to $208,000. That figure does sit well above the broader industry average published by federal labor agencies, yet underscores the steady growth of the past decade. The rapid advance of new technology and automation is helping to spur engineering wages higher, while chronic staffing shortages have driven compensation up for pilots as well as aircraft technicians.
body_zh: 波音公司最近的一份合同更新已将该公司工程师工会的平均工资推高至 208,000 美元，这说明了航空航天工资的上升趋势。这一数字确实远高于联邦劳工机构公布的更广泛的行业平均水平，但突显了过去十年的稳定增长。新技术和自动化的快速发展有助于刺激工程人员工资上涨，而长期的人员短缺则推动了飞行员和飞机技术人员的薪酬上涨。

title_en: JetBlue Will Offer Unlimited Free First Class Upgrades To Mosaic Elites
title_zh: 捷蓝航空将为马赛克精英提供无限制免费头等舱升级
summary: JetBlue will offer unlimited complimentary space available first class upgrades to Mosaic elites and Premier Card holders starting in December 2026, clearing 60 minutes before departure.
summary_zh: 从 2026 年 12 月开始，捷蓝航空将为 Mosaic 精英和 Premier 卡持有者提供无限制的免费头等舱升舱空间
body_en: In December 2026, JetBlue will finally start rolling out its new first class product , which will eventually be installed on aircraft without the carrier’s Mint business class. The airline had indicated that elite members would be eligible for complimentary space available upgrades to this product, and we now have all the details (note that this is separate from being able to use Premium Upgrade Certificates to upgrade to BlueFirst in advance).
How JetBlue’s first class upgrades for elites will work

body_en: A French military aircraft crashed near Nancy in northeastern France late on October 20, 2026, prompting a major overnight search operation. Local media reported that the aircraft may have been a Mirage 2000 fighter jet based at Nancy-Ochey Air Base.

Henry Lemoine, mayor of Pont-à-Mousson, said on Facebook that the aircraft crashed at approximately 23:35 local time in an area between Rogéville, Domèvre-en-Haye and Tremblecourt, roughly 20 kilometers (12 miles) northwest of Nancy.
The mayor said debris had been spotted by a drone and that substantial firefighting and gendarmerie resources had been deployed.

According to ICI Lorraine , witnesses reported hearing a loud explosion and seeing a fireball in the sky. Emergency responders included firefighters from the Meurthe-et-Moselle department, military firefighters from Nancy-Ochey and gendarmerie personnel. A helicopter also participated in the search.
French military confirms Mirage 2000D crash details

In a statement issued on October 21, 2026, the French Ministry of the Armed Forces confirmed that the aircraft belonged to Fighter Squadron 2/3 “Champagne”, based at Nancy-Ochey Air Base (BA 133). The Mirage 2000D crashed near Rogéville at approximately 22:40 local time on October 20, while returning from a mission.

The aircraft was carrying two crew members: a fighter pilot and a weapons systems officer (NOSA). The ministry confirmed that one body had been recovered but was awaiting identification. Search operations were continuing for the second crew member.

title_en: United CEO Scott Kirby Wants Compulsory National Service & A Wealth Tax
title_zh: 美联航首席执行官斯科特·柯比希望强制国民服役和财富税
summary: United CEO Scott Kirby doubled down on his call for a national wealth tax in a Bloomberg TV interview, and now he's also pushing compulsory national service.
summary_zh: 曼联首席执行官斯科特·柯比（Scott Kirby）在接受彭博电视台采访时加倍呼吁征收国家财富税，现在他还在推动强制性国家财富税
body_en: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby is quite the guy. It’s not just what he has to say about the industry, but also what he has to say that doesn’t involve the industry. In this case, he’s doubling down on the concept of a national wealth tax, and he’s adding the concept of compulsory national service to the mix.
United CEO has opinions on taxes & national service

Recently, United’s CEO had an interview where he talked about how “wealth inequality has become a danger to our society, and we need to address that,” and he suggested “we should have a national wealth tax,” and “we should have inheritance taxes that get close to 100 percent at some level,” and he “would pay them.” Kirby is of course a very wealthy guy , and he has taken home $84.8 million from his job as United CEO in the past three years alone.

That wasn’t just a one-off statement, but in a Bloomberg TV interview on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, Kirby doubled down on his beliefs, and added more to the mix. He explained that “the basic concept is one of fairness,” and that “if you’re wealthy enough, you can have passive income, you can just make an investment and the laws are set up that you literally never pay taxes on all that growth that can happen.”

He was then asked if he would be willing to redistribute some of his wealth to United employees earning far less than he does, to which he responded “of course not,” and that “even if Elon Musk decided to do it, and he’s a trillionaire, it’s not enough to make a difference.”

body_en: American Airlines has just reported its Q3 2026 results , and the results are pretty rough. What’s worse is the full year guidance for the airline, as the airline now expects to have a significant loss for the year.

While higher fuel prices have of course been a challenge for airlines, Delta, Southwest, and United, all still plan to make healthy profits this year. Unfortunately American is now joining the list of money-losing airlines in the United States…
American expects significant full year loss in 2026

The trends we’ve seen broadly in the US airline industry have been pretty consistent. Demand has remained strong, and airlines have been able to raise fares , but not quite enough to offset the massive increases we’ve seen in fuel bills.

For Q3 2026, American lost $269 million. That’s obviously not good, but American has gotten to the point where Q3 is regularly a money loser, as the company lost $114 million during the same period last year.

Of course the airline also highlights the positives — American had record revenue for the quarter of $16.3 billion, up 19.3% year-over-year, above the high end of the previously announced guidance. The airline also highlights how it delivered the best unit cost performance among the network carriers.
The roughest detail in all of this is American’s updated guidance for 2026:

After Q1 earnings, the airline updated guidance to have earnings per share of -$0.40 to $1.10

summary_zh: Autoflight V5000 矩阵 william.moore@…
body_en: The V5000 Matrix is a lift-plus-cruise hybrid-electric/all-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft being developed by AutoFlight Europe GmbH. Unveiled in February 2026, the aircraft performed a remotely piloted transition from thrustborne hover to wingborne cruise, demonstrating that flight testing is already underway. Industry commentators have suggested that entry into service could be as soon as 2027/2028, although there is no confirmation of this. Certification is to be sought from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) under powered-lift regulations. Structure and Powertrain The Matrix pushes regulations to their maximum, being a 10 seat eVTOL with a maximum take-off weight of 5,700kg (hybrid version). The aircraft could be configured in a 6-seat VIP layout, or a 9-seat business layout plus a pilot. It will also feature a lavatory, the first eVTOL design to incorporate this, an indication of its lengthier flight duration capabilities. An uncrewed cargo variant is also in development. The intended market is more regional-focused than previous eVTOL designs. Structurally, the V5000 is an evolution of the previous Autoflight Prosperity I and CarryAll cargo variant. It features a long, aerodynamic cabin with panoramic viewing windows and skid-style landing gear. A main high wing is complemented by two smaller wings to the front and rear of the aircraft, with three booms extending across all three wings parallel to the cabin, on each side. 20 two-blade fixed propellers are mounted to the six booms to provide lift, while eight cruise propellers provide forward thrust, four mounted to the front and four to the rear. title_en: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal
title_zh: 土耳其签署价值 110 亿美元的欧洲战斗机协议
summary: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017
summary_zh: 土耳其签署价值 110 亿美元的欧洲战斗机协议 hockensmithawi…
body_en: Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017. Twenty new-built aircraft will be purchased in the country’s first acquisition of a European combat aircraft after decades of operating new and secondhand U.S.-built fighters. But Turkey’s Eurofighter order could more than double in size, according to Turkish Defense Minister Yasar Guler. He declared that Ankara would also buy another 24 aircraft second hand, 12 each from Oman and Qatar. If those sales go through, Oman would be giving up Eurofighter operations. With deliveries of the new-build aircraft not due until 2030, delivering those second-hand aircraft—potentially as early as next year from Qatar, according to Guler—would allow Turkey to accelerate the Eurofighter’s entry into service and enable the retirement of older aircraft from its inventory, including the McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom. BAE Systems, which will produce the newly built aircraft in Warton, England, says it will receive £5.4 billion of the £8 billion deal. Included in the £5.4 billion are the aircraft and the weapons package from MBDA, including some integration work, potentially for Turkish indigenous weaponry. The remaining £2.6 billion is support and training activity, which will be contracted later, BAE Systems officials say. It is unclear whether the deal will ultimately include offsets to enable Turkish industry to become involved in the Eurofighter program and for Turkey to have a level of freedom of action for the fleet. After decades of facing numerous arms embargoes, Turkey often demands the ability to locally perform airframe, system and engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) in-country. The deal was struck during a meeting between UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan in Ankara. Starmer said the deal was a win for British workers and the wider UK defense industry. Government officials claim the order is “saving the Warton production line,” after concerns about a lack of new orders for UK-built Typhoons were expressed by workers unions. UK industry has a 37% share in the Eurofighter program and production of major component assemblies is being ramped up thanks to orders from the other Eurofighter partner nations including Germany, Italy and Spain. “Today’s announcement extends Typhoon production and preserves crucial sovereign skills which underpin the UK’s defense and security,” BAE Systems CEO Charles Woodburn said. The deal is another major boost for the UK defense industry, coming just weeks after the UK’s Type 26 frigates were selected by Norway in a £10 billion deal. UK Defense Secretary John Healey said the deal went beyond the procurement of aircraft. “It is the leading edge of the growing defense and industrial partnership between our two nations,” he said. As part of the visit, Starmer also visited the facilities of Turkish Aerospace Industries, where he was shown the indigenous Kaan combat aircraft. He was also exposed to the Hurjet advanced jet trainer, a potential candidate to replace the BAE Systems Hawk jet trainer in the UK Royal Air Force (RAF) inventory. The deal follows three years of negotiations, which have included lobbying of the German government for Berlin to lift a restriction on a Eurofighter sale after Erdoğan’s government arrested Istanbul Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu, who is seen as a serious presidential rival to Erdoğan in upcoming elections. The administration of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz lifted the sanctions in part because of the benefit to German industry. A memorandum of understanding between the UK and Turkish governments for a Eurofighter sale was agreed to in July. Turkey’s interest in the aircraft is driven in part by a need for a more capable air combat platform to be available in the interim until advanced versions of the Kaan aircraft are produced in the 2030s. Ankara’s decision to opt for a European fighter, meanwhile, will have been driven by a need to diversify sources of supply after facing sanctions from the U.S. over its purchase of a Russian air defense system and banishment from the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter program. The transfer of Omani and Qatari aircraft to Turkey begs questions over the future of additional Eurofighter orders from Qatar, which has long been linked to orders for a further 12 aircraft for a total of 36. Oman, meanwhile, appears to want to consolidate its fighter fleet around the Lockheed Martin F-16 Block 50. In BAE Systems’ 2023 full-year results, the company revealed that the Omani air force had chosen not to renew support arrangements for its Typhoons, and it is unclear how active that fleet now is. Buying these additional aircraft would mean Turkey would have a mix of three configurations in its fleet. Qatar’s aircraft have the Mk.0 version of the active electronically scanned array European Common Radar System (ECRS) radar, while Oman’s feature the mechanically scanned Captor sensor. In addition to the Eurofighter order, Erdoğan and Starmer also revealed they were working on a new trade and security pact.

title_zh: 第二架 B-21 在帕姆代尔进行飞行测试
summary: Second B-21 Enters Flight Test In Palmdale hockensmithawi… Thu, 09/11/2025 - 18:36 The B-21 Raider program completed the first flight of a second airborne test aircraft in Palmdale, California on Sept. 11, clearing a key milestone a month before the 10th anniv
summary_zh: 第二架 B-21 在棕榈谷进行飞行测试 hockensmithawi…
body_en: The B-21 Raider program completed the first flight of a second airborne test aircraft in Palmdale, California on Sept. 11, clearing a key milestone a month before the 10th anniversary of the U.S. Air Force contract award to Northrop Grumman. Witnesses posted video on social media showing the B-21 flight-test aircraft passing overhead with wheels retracted and followed by a Lockheed Martin F-16 chase plane. “We can now expedite critical evaluations of mission systems and weapons capabilities, directly supporting the strategic deterrence and combat effectiveness envisioned for this aircraft,” Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said. Northrop assembles all B-21s inside Building 401 on Site 4 of the Air Force’s Plant 42 complex at Palmdale Regional Airport. New test aircraft must fly out of the public airport after they have been assembled, before they can relocate to the secure area of nearby Edwards Air Force Base. The milestone comes nearly 22 months after Northrop completed the maiden sortie of the first flight test version of the B-21 on Nov. 10, 2023. The company has also delivered to the Air Force two more fully assembled airframes, which are reserved for static and fatigue testing on the ground. Two more flight-test aircraft have been in some stage of assembly since at least February 2022. Air Force officials say the program remains on track to clear the initial operational capability milestone in the mid-2020s. Northrop won the $21.4 billion contract in October 2015 for the engineering and manufacturing development phase of the Long-Range Strike Bomber, which the Air Force later rechristened as the B-21 Raider. The Air Force also signed orders with Northrop for the first two-year lots of low-rate initial production.
body_zh: B-21 Raider 项目于 9 月 11 日在加利福尼亚州帕姆代尔完成了第二架机载测试机的首飞，在美国空军授予诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司合同 10 周年前一个月实现了一个重要的里程碑。目击者在社交媒体上发布的视频显示，轮子收起的 B-21 试飞机从头顶飞过，后面跟着一架洛克希德·马丁公司的 F-16 追击机。空军部长特洛伊·梅克说：“我们现在可以加快对任务系统和武器能力的关键评估，直接支持这架飞机的战略威慑和战斗力。”诺斯罗普公司在帕姆代尔地区机场空军 42 号工厂 4 号基地的 401 号楼内组装所有 B-21。新的测试飞机必须在组装后飞离公共机场，然后才能转移到附近爱德华兹空军基地的安全区域。这一里程碑是在诺斯罗普公司于 2023 年 11 月 10 日完成 B-21 首次飞行测试版本的首次飞行近 22 个月后实现的。该公司还向空军交付了两架组装更齐全的机身，用于地面静态和疲劳测试。至少自 2022 年 2 月起，另外两架飞行测试飞机已进入组装阶段。空军官员表示，该计划仍在按计划进行，将在 2020 年代中期实现初始作战能力里程碑。诺斯罗普公司于 2015 年 10 月赢得了价值 214 亿美元的合同，用于远程攻击轰炸机的工程和制造开发阶段，空军后来将其重新命名为 B-21 袭击者。空军还与诺斯罗普公司签署了前两年批量低速初始生产的订单。

Amex Platinum $600 hotel credit change as of 2027
Currently, the American Express Platinum Card® ( learn more ) and The Business Platinum Card® from American Express ( learn more ) offer up to $600 per year in hotel credits .

To take advantage of this, you just have to book a prepaid hotel through Fine Hotels + Resorts® (no minimum stay through 2026) or The Hotel Collection (two-night minimum stay) through American Express Travel®. The credit is semi-annual, so you get one credit in January through June, and one credit in July through December.
However, a major restriction will be added here. As of 2027, you’ll need a two-night minimum stay to use the credit, even at Fine Hotels + Resorts properties:
Effective January 1, 2027, Fine Hotels + Resorts bookings will require a minimum two-night stay to be eligible for the $600 Lodging Credit.

body_en: Embraer and Alliance Airlines have renewed their component support agreement for the Australian carrier’s fleet of Embraer E190s, the manufacturer announced in Singapore on October 22, 2026.

Under the agreement, Embraer will continue repairing components for Alliance’s E190s, which make up the largest fleet of the type in Australia. According to Embraer, the arrangement will provide the airline with a cost-effective way to keep its aircraft reliable while managing maintenance costs. Alliance has operated E190s since 2021.
Embraer says E-Jets have boosted regional connectivity in Australia

“Alliance Airlines’ E-Jets have been instrumental in enhancing Australia’s regional connectivity,” said Carlos Naufel, President and CEO of Embraer Services & Support. He added that Embraer would continue to provide the maintenance solutions and support the airline needs as it grows.

Alliance specializes in aircraft, crew, maintenance and insurance (ACMI) leasing, as well as contract and charter flights. It operates more than 70 aircraft and serves the mining, energy and government sectors, along with providing wet-lease services to Qantas and Virgin Australia.
Australia is one of Embraer’s key markets in Asia-Pacific

Embraer delivered its first aircraft in Australia in 1978. Today, six Australian operators close fly nearly 70 E-Jets, serving regional routes and supporting fly-in, fly-out (FIFO) services that carry workers to mining and resources sites.

summary_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 局长布莱恩·贝德福德 (Bryan Bedford) 表示愿意研究替代方案，以允许......
body_en: US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Administrator Bryan Bedford is signaling a willingness to examine alternatives that could allow single-pilot operations in certain older Cessna Citation jets, while defending the agency’s decision to withdraw the exemptions that previously permitted those flights.

During a one-on-one conversation opening the Meet the Regulators session at NBAA-BACE 2026 in Las Vegas, Bedford welcomed further discussion of an approach involving supplemental aircraft certification, calling it “an interesting process” and “worthy of scrutiny.”

NBAA Senior Vice President of Government Affairs Kristie Greco Johnson, who led the discussion, raised the possibility of additional training and a supplemental type certificate as a way forward. She said NBAA is working with the Citation Jet Pilots Association to identify options for affected operators.
Bedford maintained that any alternative must meet the FAA’s safety requirements.
“If we can’t get to at least an equivalent level of safety, we shouldn’t be entertaining it,” he said.

The FAA’s policy, effective September 29, 2026, ended the issuance of the training exemptions and required existing approvals to be rescinded. The exemptions had allowed qualifying pilots to fly certain Citations whose operating limitations otherwise require two pilots.
Affected models include the Citation and Citation I, Citation II, S/II, V, Ultra, Bravo, Encore and Encore+.
body_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 局长布莱恩·贝德福德 (Bryan Bedford) 表示愿意研究允许某些老式塞斯纳奖状喷气式飞机进行单飞行员操作的替代方案，同时为该机构撤销此前允许这些航班的豁免的决定进行辩护。
在拉斯维加斯 NBAA-BACE 2026 会议监管机构会议开幕式的一对一对话中，贝德福德欢迎进一步讨论涉及补充飞机认证的方法，称其为“一个有趣的过程”且“值得仔细审查”。
主持讨论的 NBAA 政府事务高级副总裁克里斯蒂·格雷科·约翰逊 (Kristie Greco Johnson) 提出了额外培训和补充型式证书作为前进方向的可能性。她说 NBAA 正在与奖状喷气式飞机飞行员协会合作，为受影响的运营商确定选择。
贝德福德坚持认为任何替代方案都必须满足美国联邦航空局的安全要求。
“如果我们不能达到至少同等的安全水平，我们就不应该接受它，”他说。

body_en: In early 2025, Frontier Airlines announced plans to introduce first class , along with several other initiatives intended to become more competitive when it comes to premium demand and loyalty. While first class was initially supposed to be rolled out as of late 2025, that timeline didn’t stick.

There’s now an update, as we have more of a sense of when this product will launch. For that matter, we’ve learned more about the soft product, and this will be even more basic than we were expecting…
Frontier Airlines first class formally launches March 2027

View from the Wing reports on a memo to Frontier flight attendants, about the carrier’s rollout of first class. For context, Frontier plans to reconfigure its entire fleet to add eight first class seats at the front of the cabin, with two rows of seats in a 2-2 configuration. Specifically, the airline has selected the Geven Comoda seating platform.

Up until now, we haven’t known the timeline for this being introduced, though now we know. The expectation is that Frontier will start reconfiguring planes with first class as of late October 2026, and then seats will be on sale for travel as of March 5, 2027. So while the seats will already be in service, and some customers will luck out, that’s the formal launch plan.

The expectation is that all planes will have first class by then. That’s obviously a fast timeline, but keep in mind most of the cabin will remain unchanged, so it shouldn’t take much time to reconfigure each aircraft.
body_zh: 2025年初， Frontier Airlines宣布计划推出头等舱，以及其他几项旨在在高端需求和忠诚度方面提高竞争力的举措。虽然头等舱最初应该在2025年底推出，但这个时间表并没有坚持下去。
现在有一个更新，因为我们对此产品何时推出有更多的了解。因此，我们对软产品有了更多的了解，这将比我们预期的更加基本……
Frontier Airlines头等舱于2027年3月正式开通
从Wing报告中查看给Frontier空乘人员的备忘录，该备忘录涉及承运人推出头等舱。作为背景， Frontier计划重新配置其整个车队，在客舱前部增加八个头等舱座位，其中两排座位为2-2配置。具体而言，该航空公司选择了Geven Comoda座椅平台。

title_en: Gulfstream adds first fully outfitted G400 to flight-test program
title_zh: 湾流将首台装备齐全的 G400 添加到飞行测试计划中
summary: Gulfstream has started flight testing the first G400 fitted with a complete passenger cabin, taking another step toward… The post Gulfstream adds first fully outfitted G400 to flight-test program appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 湾流已开始对第一架配备完整客舱的 G400 进行飞行测试，朝着……又迈出了一步……
body_en: Gulfstream has started flight testing the first G400 fitted with a complete passenger cabin, taking another step toward certification of the new business jet as it showcased the aircraft at NBAA-BACE 2026 in Las Vegas.

The aircraft flew from Dallas Love Field (DAL) for 2 hours and 46 minutes, reaching 48,000 feet. Its 11-passenger interior, arranged across two-and-a-half living areas, will allow Gulfstream to evaluate cabin systems and passenger comfort in flight.

The company also announced a Miami–Las Vegas speed record set by another G400 traveling to the show. That aircraft completed the trip in 4 hours and 8 minutes at an average speed of Mach 0.89, using a blend of sustainable aviation fuel.
“The aircraft continues to perform exceptionally well as we advance through the rigorous certification program,” Gulfstream President Mark Burns said.
The G400 has also undergone high-altitude testing in Telluride, Colorado, and cold-weather testing in Iqaluit, Canada.
Gulfstream introduced the G400 in 2021 with a base price of $34.5 million. The company has not announced a revised certification date.

The latest flight comes more than two years after the G400 first flew in August 2024, launching the aircraft’s flight-test program. Powered by two Pratt & Whitney Canada PW812GA engines, the jet joins a family of Gulfstream aircraft developed around new wing, engine and cockpit technology.
Gulfstream lists the G400’s projected range at 4,200 nautical miles at Mach 0.85 with eight passengers, three crew and fuel reserves. Its planned maximum operating speed is Mach 0.90.
body_zh: 湾流已开始对第一架配备完整客舱的 G400 进行飞行测试，在拉斯维加斯 NBAA-BACE 2026 上展示该飞机时，朝着新型公务机的认证又迈出了一步。
飞机从达拉斯爱​​田 (DAL) 起飞，飞行了 2 小时 46 分钟，到达 48,000 英尺的高度。其内部可容纳 11 名乘客，分布在两个半的起居区，湾流将能够评估客舱系统和乘客在飞行中的舒适度。
该公司还宣布了另一辆参加展会的 G400 创造的迈阿密-拉斯维加斯速度记录。该飞机使用可持续航空燃料混合物，以 0.89 马赫的平均速度在 4 小时 8 分钟内完成了此次旅程。
湾流总裁马克·伯恩斯 (Mark Burns) 表示：“随着我们通过严格的认证计划，这架飞机将继续表现出色。”
G400 还在科罗拉多州特柳赖德进行了高海拔测试，并在加拿大伊卡卢伊特进行了寒冷天气测试。
湾流于 2021 年推出 G400，底价为 3450 万美元。该公司尚未宣布修改后的认证日期。

title_en: Boeing aims to shorten cabin completion times for $100 million BBJ Select
title_zh: 波音公司旨在缩短价值 1 亿美元的 BBJ Select 客舱完工时间
summary: Boeing Business Jets is targeting a shortened cabin completion process for its BBJ Select aircraft, using preconfigured interiors… The post Boeing aims to shorten cabin completion times for $100 million BBJ Select appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 波音公务机的目标是使用预先配置的内饰，缩短 BBJ Select 飞机的机舱完工流程……后波音公司的目标
body_en: Boeing Business Jets is targeting a shortened cabin completion process for its BBJ Select aircraft, using preconfigured interiors that are intended to reduce the time and cost of outfitting a private 737.

The program, first announced in 2023, is offered on the BBJ 737-7 and 737-8 and gives customers a choice of cabin layouts at a price of approximately $100 million, said Boeing Business Jets Director of Marketing Chris Shindle at NBAA-BACE 2026 in Las Vegas.

The first aircraft will take a bit longer to complete as Boeing refines the process. Shindle said he expects those projects to require about 24 to 30 months, with the process becoming faster as the completion team gains experience. The goal is to eventually reduce completion time to 18 months, he said.
BBJ Select addresses one of the biggest differences between buying an airliner-based business jet and other private aircraft: the work required to turn an empty fuselage into a finished cabin.

BBJs are built on Boeing’s regular commercial production lines, with some provisions for auxiliary fuel tanks, but leave the factory without passenger interiors. They then fly to a completion center for installation of the cabin and other equipment.

A fully customized interior requires design and engineering work specific to the customer. With Select, buyers choose from cabin sections that have already been engineered, reducing the work needed for each aircraft.
“That shortens the delivery time, reduces the cost, simplifies the product as well,” Shindle said.
body_zh: 波音公务机的目标是缩短 BBJ Select 飞机的机舱完工流程，使用预配置的内饰，旨在减少私人 737 的装备时间和成本。
波音公务机营销总监 Chris Shindle 在拉斯维加斯举行的 NBAA-BACE 2026 上表示，该计划于 2023 年首次宣布，在 BBJ 737-7 和 737-8 上提供，并为客户提供了约 1 亿美元的客舱布局选择。
随着波音公司改进流程，第一架飞机的完成时间会更长一些。 Shindle 表示，他预计这些项目需要大约 24 至 30 个月的时间，随着完成团队积累经验，这一过程会变得更快。他说，目标是最终将完成时间缩短至 18 个月。
BBJ Select 解决了购买客机商务飞机与其他私人飞机之间的最大区别之一：将空机身变成成品机舱所需的工作。
